actors.name: Speaker
actors.private_context: Speaker has just asked 'So, what do you think?' to someone, expecting a response. Speaker is waiting for the other person's opinion.

actors.name: Listener
actors.private_context: Listener has been asked 'So, what do you think?' by Speaker. Listener may have an opinion or not, and may choose to respond or not.

shared_context: Speaker and Listener are in a conversation. Speaker has just posed the question 'So, what do you think?' to Listener. The topic of the question is not specified.

starting_events.description: Speaker asks Listener 'So, what do you think?'

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Listener actually said something in response to Speaker's question before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
